Oh, no!’", "sha256": "87caa615a95fb2af6039ee944d336279eeff42763fe5cafa8f53ca56bb5f801a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[96]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0097", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "For an instant, a distressful shadow crossed her face; but, even in the start it gave me, it was gone; and she was playing on, and looking at me with her own calm smile.", "sha256": "c548a60658956ebfd7635fa5e8c518b13273de7b0470942df7919ce1ae4b9c46", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[97]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0098", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As I rode back in the lonely night, the wind going by me like a restless memory, I thought of this, and feared she was not happy.
